verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a Python/JS library invoked programmatically (graph.invoke/stream), and LangGraph CLI exists for running the Agent Server locally, implying it can be scripted/run outside interactive notebooks; durable execution, checkpointing, and pip-installable packaging further support headless automation. However, evidence is all first-party docs/GitHub with no explicit CI pipeline example, no GitHub Actions/CI integration docs, and one community comment questions production deployment story beyond local 'langgraph serve'. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation or examples, independent confirmation of headless automation in CI environments, and clarity on production deployment options beyond local serve.
